title: AS2: getter/setter property syntax (get/set)
description: Implement AS2 getter and setter properties in the compiler. AS2 syntax: 'function get width():Number { return _w; }' and 'function set width(v:Number):Void { _w = v; }' inside a class. AVM1 implementation: emit ActionDefineFunction2 (0x8E) for the getter/setter body, then emit code equivalent to Object.prototype.__defineGetter__('width', fn) / __defineSetter__. In the compiler, detect FunctionDecl with isGetter/isSetter flag. Read parser.ts to see if get/set modifiers are already parsed. Add 6 tests in __tests__/getset.test.ts.
